decisions.reason: As a two-component resin injection unit, it remains close to the firm's existing plural-component and injection knowledge, so management is likely to keep it and improve it unless overlapping variants force portfolio simplification.

This unit also builds directly on the firm's core fluid-handling and injection capabilities, and a medium-sized German machinery producer would usually exploit accumulated field learning before considering withdrawal.
A manual airless spray gun sits squarely in the firm's established application technology base, making continued commercialization and incremental refinement the most likely course.
Because this air-assisted airless spray gun line spans several models in a core technology area, management is likely to retain it as a platform for serving differentiated customer requirements.

The data logger is less central to the firm's traditional mechanical strengths, but by now it complements installed coating equipment and service learning enough that management would more likely continue developing it than abandon it.
